author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0044248 cellular catabolic process 
see (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29627#event-16124587346)

It will be replaced by/merged into: GO:0009056 catabolic process

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SOseRxmbsX8-MhfUhYlinuadCL_fzbIoys-ox1dLcf8/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
~PomBase 1~ fixed
PseudoCAP 3
Wormbase 1

No mappings

Thanks.

body: Closing: checked against the GO 2026-07-26 release, no direct annotations remain to the GO term(s) in this ticket and none are used in annotation extensions. Any that reappear will be flagged in group error reports. If there is a further problem, please open a new ticket.
